results.prediction: Iran war ceasefire or major escalation
results.description: As of March 31, 2026, neither ceasefire nor major escalation has been achieved. Iran has rejected the US 15-point peace plan and denies engaging in direct negotiations, while Trump claims talks are ongoing. The conflict continues with US-Israel strikes targeting Iranian nuclear facilities and Iran conducting counter-strikes on Gulf states.

results.prediction: Strait of Hormuz full shipping restoration
results.description: The Strait of Hormuz remains effectively closed with severe disruptions continuing into mid-March 2026, marking the most serious threat to free navigation in modern times. An estimated 2,000 ships are stranded on either side of the waterway, with only select vessels from China, India, Pakistan, and Malaysia receiving Iranian clearance for passage. Transit volumes show an approximate 80% drop from normal levels, with no clear timeline for full restoration.
